categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes address discovery logic in src/net.cpp for Tor and I2P connections.
categories.rationale: Prevents an identity correlation vector between clearnet and privacy networks for nodes using custom ports. As noted in the description, an adversarial peer could supply an arbitrary routable address in addrMe that gets reflected back in self-advertisements alongside the node's listening port, creating an identity fingerprint.
